newsitem.title: UK: CE says had 49.77 pct of Northern Electric.
newsitem.headline: CE says had 49.77 pct of Northern Electric.

text.p: U.S. group CE Electric said on Saturday it had received valid acceptances representing 49.77 percent of British regional electricity company Northern Electric when the 1300 GMT Friday deadline on its bid was extended.

CE Electric, a unit of Calenergy Co Inc, said late Friday that its bid had been extended until 1300 GMT on December 24 following a hearing of Britain's takeover panel. The panel is yet to issue a statement detailing its reasons for the extension.
The 782 million sterling takeover offer has sparked furious arguments with both companies protesting to the takeover panel about the other's tactics.
